entries.note: PubMed 10213228 resolves; quote verbatim; untested stands. Entry note overstates: the abstract reports growth inhibition only, no EGFR-blockade readout in xenografts; the animal-PD claim lives in label 12.1 (model_filed true confirmed there).

DOI resolves; quote verbatim (abstract). Skin biopsies are within-patient PD; no xenograft data beside them (comparison_stated false is right). No published model-vs-patient comparison, so cell stays untested from 1999. Also EMR 62202-047 is OPUS (NCT00125034), not this phase I.
PubMed 12006511 resolves; quote verbatim; untested stands (no model exposure target published). Baselga 2000 saturation rationale cited in the judgement was not re-verified within budget.

Resolves; quote verbatim; untested stands. Genotypes now sourced: Cellosaurus CVCL_0271 GEO KRAS p.G12A heterozygous (PubMed 20570890); CVCL_0248 DLD-1 KRAS p.G13D (Shirasawa 1993, doi:10.1126/science.8465203); CVCL_0320 HT-29 BRAF p.V600E (Davies 2002, PMID 12068308).

DOI resolves; quote verbatim. Direction matches Prewett 2002 refractory model, but the BOND abstract makes no model comparison (full text paywalled); comparison_stated false. Under rule 1 a juxtaposition is untested; keep `same` only if juxtaposition is ruled admissible.

DOI resolves; quote verbatim but patient-only (no model comparison). Model side also wrong: Prewett 2002 refractory DLD-1/HT-29 failed C225 monotherapy; DLD-1 is G13D, sensitive in patients, cells and mice (De Roock 2010). Drop; Benvenuti 2007 states agreement (see missing).

DOI resolves; quote verbatim; comparison stated in-source, so `same` holds for PDX. Had the 2006 contra stood, the override rule makes this entry contra (validity belongs to the context, not the model); `same` is valid only with the contra dropped.

DailyMed resolves; quote verbatim (5.4). Untested stands. Section 13 verified: only cynomolgus menstrual-cycle and male-fertility findings, no skin or magnesium; but section 13 is regulatory-scoped, so label silence is not model silence. Year 2004 is approval, not a comparison year.

missing: efficacy, cell-line model, 2007, `same`, comparison_stated true: Benvenuti 2007 Cancer Res 67:2643 (doi:10.1158/0008-5472.CAN-06-4158) correlates KRAS/BRAF mutation with anti-EGFR non-response in mCRC patients AND shows in the same paper that 'In cellular models of CRCs, activation of the RAS signaling pathway by introduction of an activated K-RAS allele (Gly(12)Val) impairs the therapeutic effect of anti-EGFR mAbs.' This is the first primary source that puts model and patient side by side for the RAS question, and it reports agreement (retrodiction), not contradiction. It should replace the 2006 contra.

efficacy, cell-line + mouse model, 2010, `same`, comparison_stated true: De Roock 2010 JAMA 304:1812 (doi:10.1001/jama.2010.1535), 579 pooled patients (CO.17, BOND, MABEL...) plus isogenic cells and a mouse model: 'although p.G12V-mutated colorectal cells were insensitive to cetuximab, p.G13D-mutated cells were sensitive, as were KRAS wild-type cells', matching longer OS/PFS in G13D patients (adjusted HR 0.50). Directly undercuts using DLD-1 (G13D) as the model's 'wrong' prediction.

efficacy, cell-line model, 2012, `same`, comparison_stated true: Misale 2012 Nature (doi:10.1038/nature11156), already cited in the drafter's judgement, is a forward prediction (KRAS mutations selected by cetuximab in vitro, then found in progressing patients' metastases and plasma). The drafter withheld it only because of the override; once the contra is dropped it is a scoreable `same`. DOI not re-verified within budget.

efficacy, BRAF: Di Nicolantonio 2008 JCO (BRAF V600E in patients plus engineered cell lines) would source the HT-29 genotype side of the comparison the same way Benvenuti does for KRAS; not verified within budget.
engagement: no source found that places xenograft pEGFR/pMAPK beside the patient skin PD; unless one exists the cell should end untested.

registry correction for the Tabernero 2010 judgement text: EMR 62202-047 is the OPUS trial (NCT00125034, results first posted 2011-10-04), not the every-second-week phase I; a ClinicalTrials.gov search for the phase I returned nothing, so registry_date null stands but the trial number must be fixed. NCT00113763 results-first-posted 2014-01-03 confirmed.

safety: the model-side evidence (cynomolgus skin or magnesium findings) is still unverified; the 2004 Erbitux and 2006 Vectibix FDA pharmacology reviews are the only sources that could move this cell.
rule_questions: Juxtaposition: DRAFTER_BRIEF v2 carries `comparison_stated: false if you juxtaposed two sources yourself`, which implies a drafter may juxtapose and still score `same`/`contra`; rule 1 and the checker brief say any status other than untested needs a PRIMARY source that makes the comparison. I applied the strict reading (engagement 2, efficacy 2, efficacy 3 -> untested). If juxtaposition is admissible, engagement 2 and efficacy 2 may stay `same`; efficacy 3 still fails on the model-side facts.

Override across a model change: the draft goes contra (cell-line xenografts, 2006) then same (PDX, 2011) and calls the second a change of best model. The brief says contra 'overrides every matched status' and validity belongs to the context, not the model, so a `same` cannot follow a `contra` in the same cell; the cell would read contra from 2006 onward with the PDX match recorded in a note. The brief needs an explicit rule for model changes (e.g. a model-change entry that inherits the current status).

Population axis: the context is RAS wild-type. The KRAS-mutant non-response (Lievre 2006) is a result in the population the label later excluded. Does a model miss in the excluded population count against the RAS-WT context, or does it belong to a sibling context (CRC x RAS-mutant x anti-EGFR)?

Retrodiction: Benvenuti 2007, De Roock 2010 and Bertotti 2011 are retrospective concordances (model run after the patient result). The `same` rule says 'the model's prediction agreed with patient results'; the draft already treats Bertotti as `same`, so retrodiction appears accepted, but it should be stated.

Source form for untested entries: Clin Cancer Res 1999/2002 have no DOI; PubMed URLs are used. Rule 1's DOI requirement reads as applying to statuses other than untested; confirm PubMed URLs are acceptable for untested entries.

Label silence as model silence: a label's section 13 is restricted by regulation to carcinogenesis/mutagenesis/fertility. The drafter correctly did not score safety contra on it; the brief should say that only a pharmacology/toxicology review (not section 13) can establish the model's silence.
